Aipas S1 AMP Electric Dirt Bike Overview
The Aipas S1 AMP is a 4000W electric dirt bike for adults who want serious off-road power, fast acceleration, and full-suspension control. With 255 Nm of torque, a 50 mph top speed, and a 60V 28Ah removable battery, the S1 AMP is built for dirt tracks, trails, gravel, steep climbs, and open outdoor riding.
Unlike a standard commuter ebike, the S1 AMP is designed around dirt-bike-style performance. Its mid-drive motor, full suspension system, hydraulic braking setup, high-output lighting, and compact dirt-bike-style frame make it a stronger fit for adult riders who want high torque, responsive control, and more off-road capability.
Always ride according to local laws, trail rules, and safety requirements.
4000W Power for Off-Road Riding
At the core of the S1 AMP is a 4000W mid-drive motor designed for strong acceleration and high-torque riding. With up to 255 Nm of torque and a max 70° gradient rating, this electric dirt bike gives adult riders the power needed for steep climbs, loose terrain, and demanding off-road routes.
This setup makes the S1 AMP better suited for trails, dirt tracks, gravel paths, open outdoor areas, and private off-road routes than for ordinary city commuting.
60V 28Ah Battery for Longer Outdoor Sessions
The removable 60V 28Ah lithium battery provides up to 60 miles of electric-only range on a single charge. It supports longer trail sessions, outdoor riding, and extended off-road use while allowing easier charging at home or on the go.
For adult riders who want an electric dirt bike with both high output and practical range, this battery setup helps balance power, distance, and riding flexibility.
Three Riding Modes for Different Terrain
The S1 AMP includes three power modes so riders can adjust output based on terrain and riding style.

ECO Mode
Warm-up riding, lower-speed control, longer range
Helps conserve battery and makes the bike easier to manage at slower speeds.

Sport Mode
Hills, rough ground, mixed terrain
Adds stronger torque and acceleration for more demanding off-road routes.

Turbo Mode
Maximum speed, full power, high-output riding
Unlocks the strongest motor response for aggressive dirt bike performance.

This mode system helps the S1 AMP work across different off-road conditions instead of feeling locked into one riding style.
Full Suspension for Rough Ground
The S1 AMP uses front and rear suspension to help absorb bumps, uneven ground, and trail impact. The hydraulic front fork and center-mounted rear shock absorber help improve control, reduce rider fatigue, and make the bike more stable on dirt, gravel, and rough outdoor surfaces.
For an electric dirt bike for adults, suspension is not just a comfort feature. It directly affects control, traction, and confidence when riding over uneven terrain.
Safety and Control at Higher Speeds
For better visibility and control, the S1 AMP includes a 2000-lumen headlight, integrated brake lights, turn signals, and a precision braking system. These features help adult riders stay more confident when riding at higher speeds or navigating changing outdoor conditions.
Because the S1 AMP can reach up to 50 mph, braking, lighting, and rider awareness are especially important parts of the riding experience.
Built for Adult Riders
The S1 AMP supports up to 350 lb and fits riders from 4'2" to 6'0". With its 105 lb net weight, dirt-bike-style frame, full-twist throttle, folding footrests, and high-output mid-drive motor, it is better positioned as an electric dirt bike for adults than a standard commuter ebike.
Its frame and power system are designed for riders who want stronger acceleration, more torque, and better off-road handling than a typical electric bike.
Who Is the S1 AMP Electric Dirt Bike Best For?
The S1 AMP is best for adult riders who want more power than a standard ebike and a more off-road-focused ride than a commuter electric bike.

Adult off-road riders
The 4000W motor, 255 Nm torque, and full suspension are built for trails, dirt tracks, and rough outdoor terrain.

Riders who need strong climbing power
The high-torque mid-drive motor helps with steep climbs, loose ground, and demanding routes.

Riders who want dirt-bike-style control
The full-twist throttle, folding footrests, suspension system, and compact frame create a more dirt-bike-like riding feel.

Riders who want high-speed electric performance
With a top speed of up to 50 mph, the S1 AMP is designed for riders who want more speed headroom than a standard ebike.

Adults looking for a powerful recreational ride
It is a strong fit for outdoor riding, private off-road routes, gravel, dirt paths, and weekend trail use.

The S1 AMP is not positioned as a lightweight city commuter. It is better for riders who want a high-power electric dirt bike built around torque, speed, suspension, and off-road control.
If you want a more traditional bicycle-style ride for trails, gravel, and rough roads, compare the S1 AMP with Aipas off-road electric bikes.
How S1 AMP Specs Affect Off-Road Riding

4000W Mid-Drive Motor
Delivers stronger acceleration and better power delivery for dirt tracks, trails, steep climbs, and rough terrain.

255 Nm Torque
Helps with hill starts, loose ground, heavier loads, and high-demand off-road riding.

50 mph Top Speed
Gives the S1 AMP a performance feel closer to an electric dirt bike than a standard commuter ebike.

60V 28Ah Battery
Supports longer outdoor riding sessions and up to 60 miles of electric-only range.

Full Suspension
Helps absorb bumps, trail impact, uneven ground, and rough outdoor surfaces.

350 lb Load Capacity
Supports a wider range of adult riders and riding gear.

105 lb Net Weight
Gives the bike a more planted dirt-bike-style feel, but it is not intended to be a lightweight portable commuter ebike.

14×3 Front / 12×3 Rear Tires
Creates a compact dirt-bike-style setup designed for traction, control, and off-road handling.

70° Max Gradient Rating
Shows the bike is built for serious climbing support on steep off-road terrain.

This is the section that helps users understand the difference between “big numbers” and real riding benefits. It also helps Google connect the product’s specs with electric dirt bike search intent.
Electric Dirt Bike vs Regular Ebike: What Makes the S1 Different?
The S1 AMP is still part of the Aipas electric bike lineup, but its riding purpose is very different from a standard commuter, folding, or fat tire ebike. It is designed to feel closer to an electric dirt bike for adults.

If you want a comfortable city ebike, a commuter model may be a better fit. If you want high torque, fast acceleration, full suspension, and dirt-bike-style off-road performance, the S1 AMP is the stronger match.
The S1 AMP is the most performance-focused electric dirt bike in the Aipas lineup. Riders who want to compare it with other Aipas electric bikes can explore the full collection before choosing a model.
Gear up with accessories like the Lighted Cycling Helmet and Off-Road Protective Gear Set to complete your ultimate off-road experience.
